targets.name: server
targets.cmd: tsc -p . && mkdir -p $out/bin $out/lib && esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --log-level=warning --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=$out/lib/server.mjs && sed -i -E 's#/nix/store/[a-z0-9]{32}-npm-#/nix/store/eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee-npm-#g' $out/lib/server.mjs && printf '#!%s\nexec %s %s/lib/server.mjs "$@"\n' "$(command -v bash)" "$tool_nodejs_slim/bin/node" "$out" > $out/bin/server && chmod +x $out/bin/server
